guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Interface is reaffirming its full fiscal year earnings guidance on strong operational execution, while revising its full fiscal year net sales outlook to reflect softer conditions in Europe. With that backdrop in mind, Interface anticipates the following:

Full Fiscal Year 2026 Outlook | Previous Full Fiscal Year 2026 Outlook
Net sales | $1.440 to $1.455 billion | $1.455 to $1.485 billion
Adjusted gross profit margin | 40.4% of net sales | 40.6% of net sales
Adjusted SG&A expenses | $387 million | $395 million
Adjusted interest & other expenses | $14 million | $15 million
Adjusted effective income tax rate | 25.0% | 26.0%
Capital expenditures | $60 million | $60 million
Fully diluted weighted average share count | 58.5 million shares | 58.6 million shares
